name: fedora-44-workstation
title: Fedora 44 Workstation, GNOME (Wayland)
hints: Desktop: Fedora 44 Workstation with GNOME (Wayland session), a top bar and no permanent dock.
Apps: the text editor is Text Editor (gnome-text-editor), the file manager is Files (Nautilus), the terminal is Ptyxis (Terminal), the web browser is Firefox.
To start an app: press Super (the Windows key) to open the Activities overview, type the app name, press Enter.
Windows: alt+Tab switches windows, super+Up maximizes, alt+F4 closes the focused window.
